name: Scodix
summary: Scodix Ltd. engages in research and development, production, marketing, and sales worldwide of digital printing systems. It also provides services for the use of those systems and sells polymers and spare parts developed by it, which are used in the process of enhancement of the printing. The company was founded by Kobi Bar and Eli Grinberg on May 7, 2007 and is headquartered in Rosh Ha'Ayin, Israel.
